meta.title: OpResume — Privacy-first Resume Builder
meta.description: OpResume — a login-free, AI-powered resume builder. Privacy protected, no compromise on experience.

hero.title: Resume writing, the way it should be
hero.subtitleHtml:
OpResume — a login-free, AI-powered resume builder.
Your data never leaves your device — full privacy, zero trade-offs.

features.sub: Skip the formatting chores and privacy worries — focus on the story that matters: yours.

ai.desc: Select any sentence in your resume and refine it in one click. With intuitive red/green diff highlighting, every AI change is crystal clear — you always stay in control.
ai.point2: Auto-extracts quantified results for a more professional tone
ai.gifAlt: Demo of AI selection polish with diff comparison

drag.desc: Break free from rigid templates. A building-block, WYSIWYG design lets you add, remove and reorder every module — just drag to reshape the layout in real time.

privacy.desc: Asking the community for feedback on your resume? Turn on privacy mode to automatically mask your name, phone, email, company and other sensitive info. Screenshot and share without a second thought.
privacy.gifAlt: Demo of the one-click privacy masking mode

pdf.desc: Already have a PDF resume? Upload it and AI will accurately extract and organize your experience, filling a brand-new layout seamlessly. No more tedious copy-pasting.
pdf.gifAlt: Demo of AI PDF parsing and field auto-fill

manifesto.desc: All resume content is saved only on your local device. Your resume is no longer a file on someone else's server — it's a strictly private personal asset.

stats.database: No database. We never store any of your data.
stats.signups: No email, password or third-party sign-in. Open the page and start working.
stats.local: Core data always lives in your browser — a true client-side architecture.

faq.heading: FAQ
faq.a1: Completely free. No ads, no feature limits.
faq.q2: If it's free, how is the AI feature billed?
faq.a2: AI runs on a BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) model. Just paste in an API key from a supported AI provider — the platform takes no cut.
faq.a3: SiliconFlow is supported today. We listen closely to the community and will keep integrating more mainstream AI platforms based on your feedback.
faq.q4: Will my resume be lost if I switch computers or browsers?
faq.a4: Data is saved in your current browser only. Before switching, export a JSON backup and import it on the new device to keep editing.
faq.a5: Simplified Chinese and English are currently supported.
faq.q6: Will the exported PDF pass ATS screening?
faq.a6: Yes. PDFs are generated by the browser's native engine, so all text stays selectable and copyable. Your key terms are picked up accurately by ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems) — no garbled text, no missed keywords.

final.title: Your next leap starts here
